status.zh: 概念建议；五类对象均未确认参与，不构成政府、机构、企业、场地、数据或资源承诺
status.en: Concept proposal; none of the five counterparts has confirmed participation, and no government, institution, company, site, data, or resource commitment is claimed

proposed_agenda.zh: 适老、无屏公共服务与社区共设计
proposed_agenda.en: Age-friendly, screen-free public service and community co-design

element_flow.zh: 公开或经同意的服务问题进入原点社区原型；不含个人身份的任务测试与人工服务改进清单返回社区复核
element_flow.en: Public or consented service questions enter an Origin Community prototype; non-identifying task tests and staffed-service repair lists return for community review

responsibility_type.zh: 需求拥有者、公共服务运营者、无障碍/申诉复核人
responsibility_type.en: Need owner, public-service operator, and accessibility/appeal reviewer

verification_evidence.zh: 授权问题清单、最小数据说明、无屏任务记录、投诉与人工接管台账
verification_evidence.en: Authorised problem list, data-minimisation notice, screen-free task record, and complaint/human-takeover ledger

exit_condition.zh: 授权缺失、基本人工服务受损或投诉无法闭环时停止数字联动并保留非 AI 基线
exit_condition.en: Stop the digital link and retain the non-AI baseline if authorisation is absent, staffed service worsens, or complaints cannot close

proposed_agenda.zh: 研究问题、开发方法与可复现评测
proposed_agenda.en: Research questions, development methods, and reproducible evaluation

element_flow.zh: 公开研究问题/方法规格进入众智园受控测试；版本化日志、失败样例和边界说明返回建议科研复核
element_flow.en: Public research questions/method specifications enter controlled Zhongzhiyuan tests; versioned logs, failures, and boundary notes return for proposed research review

responsibility_type.zh: 科研联络人、方法评审人、测试运营者、数据/知识产权责任人
responsibility_type.en: Research liaison, method reviewer, test operator, and data/IP steward

verification_evidence.zh: 公开合作范围、测试协议、数据/知识产权清单、可复现报告、独立复核记录
verification_evidence.en: Public collaboration scope, test protocol, data/IP inventory, reproducibility report, and independent review record

exit_condition.zh: 权利、数据、算力或安全责任未定，或结果不可复现时不外传数据、不现场部署
exit_condition.en: Do not transfer data or deploy on site when rights, data, compute, or safety ownership is unresolved or results are not reproducible

proposed_agenda.zh: 科学仪器/大科学装置的公众理解与可解释交互
proposed_agenda.en: Public understanding and explainable interaction around scientific instruments/big-science facilities

element_flow.zh: 已公开、可转述的科研议题进入触摸模型与文化节点；理解偏差、纠错和无障碍记录返回建议科学传播复核
element_flow.en: Publicly released, reusable research topics enter tactile models and cultural nodes; comprehension gaps, corrections, and accessibility records return for proposed science-communication review

responsibility_type.zh: 内容权利责任人、科学审校人、公共传播/无障碍评测人
responsibility_type.en: Content-rights steward, scientific reviewer, and public-communication/accessibility evaluator

verification_evidence.zh: 可公开性与许可清单、内容版本、专家审校、用户理解/纠错记录
verification_evidence.en: Public-use/licence inventory, content version, expert review, and user-comprehension/correction record

exit_condition.zh: 依赖未公开/受限数据、授权或审校不完整，或纠错无法实施时下架相应内容
exit_condition.en: Remove affected content if it relies on unpublished/restricted data, authorisation or review is incomplete, or corrections cannot be implemented

proposed_agenda.zh: 生产环节、产品安全与可维护性的小规模产业验证
proposed_agenda.en: Small-scale industrial validation of production interfaces, product safety, and maintainability

element_flow.zh: 公开产品需求/工程检查表进入边缘市集或安全庭院；安全、运维、停机和撤场记录返回建议产业验证复盘
element_flow.en: Public product requirement/engineering checklists enter an edge market or safety court; safety, maintenance, shutdown, and removal records return for proposed industrial-validation review

responsibility_type.zh: 产业问题拥有者、沙箱运营者、安全/工程评审人、运维责任人
responsibility_type.en: Industry problem owner, sandbox operator, safety/engineering reviewer, and maintenance owner

verification_evidence.zh: 试验授权、沙箱边界、安全报告、版本/更改记录、停机与恢复演练
verification_evidence.en: Test authorisation, sandbox boundary, safety report, version/change record, and shutdown/restoration drill

exit_condition.zh: 场地、资源、成本、安全或运维责任未闭环，或性能不可复现时停止试验且不暗示采购/投资
exit_condition.en: Stop the test and imply neither procurement nor investment if site, resources, cost, safety, or maintenance ownership does not close, or performance is not reproducible

proposed_agenda.zh: 开放协议、跨城市场景复现与区域经验目录
proposed_agenda.en: Open protocols, cross-city scenario reproduction, and a regional lessons catalogue

element_flow.zh: 版本化场景协议和非 AI 基线进入建议区域同行节点；去标识比较结果、场地差异和失败经验进入一带开放目录
element_flow.en: Versioned scenario protocols and non-AI baselines enter proposed peer nodes; de-identified comparisons, site differences, and failures enter the Belt open catalogue

responsibility_type.zh: 区域召集人、协议管理人、各地测试责任人、独立方法复核人
responsibility_type.en: Regional convenor, protocol steward, each-site test owner, and independent methods reviewer

verification_evidence.zh: 公开征集与自愿参与记录、共同测试规格、各地基线、跨地复现报告、差异说明
verification_evidence.en: Public call and voluntary participation record, common test specification, local baselines, cross-site reproduction report, and difference note

exit_condition.zh: 无共同规则、数据流动缺乏合法/授权基础，或各地基线不可比时停止跨域绩效声称并仅公开本地结果
exit_condition.en: Stop cross-region performance claims and publish local results only if common rules are absent, data movement lacks a lawful/authorised basis, or local baselines are not comparable

admission_evidence.zh: 来源、问题拥有者、试点边界、期限和申诉责任齐备
admission_evidence.en: Source, problem owner, pilot boundary, term, and appeal owner are complete

public_fields.zh: 问题、适用范围、非 AI 基线、当前状态、更新日期
public_fields.en: Problem, applicability, non-AI baseline, current status, and update date

review_exit.zh: 每季复核；拥有者、边界或申诉链缺失即撤展

admission_evidence.zh: 版本化交付物、方法/测试记录、权利清单、专业或公众复核结论齐备
admission_evidence.en: Versioned deliverable, method/test record, rights inventory, and professional or public review are complete

public_fields.zh: 经同意的署名/角色、方法、证据、限制、纠错链接；不作不可比排名

review_exit.zh: 每次版本变更复核；证据失效、权利异议或拒不纠错即暂停

admission_evidence.zh: 续期、缩减或停止决定，恢复记录与可转用教训完整
admission_evidence.en: Renew/scale-down/stop decision, restoration record, and transferable lesson are complete

public_fields.zh: 决定依据、失败边界、恢复结果、责任类型和可公开教训
public_fields.en: Decision basis, failure boundary, restoration result, responsibility type, and publishable lesson

review_exit.zh: 年度听证/专业复核；出现隐私、安全或权利风险即下架敏感内容并保留非识别性结论
review_exit.en: Annual hearing/professional review; remove sensitive content after privacy, safety, or rights risk and retain a non-identifying conclusion

status.zh: 不指定产品、供应商、尺寸、材料、位置或数量；后续须经专业复核
status.en: No product, supplier, dimension, material, placement, or quantity is prescribed; professional review is required

minimum_baseline.zh: 无手机也可查责任、期限、人工服务和投诉方式
minimum_baseline.en: Owner, term, staffed service, and complaint route remain readable without a phone

installation_gate.zh: 责任人、文案、多语和可达性复核
installation_gate.en: Owner, wording, multilingual content, and accessibility reviewed

maintenance_evidence.zh: 月度内容/联系有效性记录

exit_action.zh: 信息失效即覆盖或撤下
exit_action.en: Cover or remove expired information immediately

minimum_baseline.zh: 试点范围、绕行与人工停止可见，基本通道不缩窄
minimum_baseline.en: Pilot extent, bypass, and staff-operated stop are visible without narrowing essential passage

installation_gate.zh: 边界、净宽、应急和人工接管测试通过
installation_gate.en: Boundary, clear width, emergency route, and human-takeover test passed

maintenance_evidence.zh: 每场开启/停止/恢复记录

exit_action.zh: 边界漂移、停止失效或通行受损即撤除全部试点件

installation_gate.zh: 无障碍、视线、排水、热环境和养护责任确认
installation_gate.en: Accessibility, sightline, drainage, heat, and maintenance ownership confirmed

maintenance_evidence.zh: 月度可用性与无屏任务记录
maintenance_evidence.en: Monthly availability and screen-free task record

exit_action.zh: 绊倒、积水、高温或无人维护风险出现即缩减/临时关闭
exit_action.en: Scale down/temporarily close after trip, water, heat, or unattended-maintenance risk

name.zh: 可拆展示与受控测试舱

minimum_baseline.zh: 实物说明、非 AI 演示和可绕行路线始终存在
minimum_baseline.en: Physical explanation, non-AI demonstration, and a bypass route always remain

installation_gate.zh: 场地授权、防火/结构、隔离供电/网络、数据和撤场方案通过
installation_gate.en: Site authorisation, fire/structure, isolated power/network, data, and removal plan passed

maintenance_evidence.zh: 每场安全、故障、能耗和撤场记录
maintenance_evidence.en: Per-session safety, failure, energy, and removal records

exit_action.zh: 授权到期、隔离失效、范围越界或不能恢复原状即停用撤场
exit_action.en: Stop and remove after authorisation expiry, isolation failure, scope breach, or inability to restore the original state

minimum_baseline.zh: 实体可读摘要、更正日期和人工纠错渠道；数字链接仅作可选补充
minimum_baseline.en: A readable physical summary, correction date, and staffed correction route are present; a digital link is optional

installation_gate.zh: 证据、署名同意、权利、隐私和无障碍复核
installation_gate.en: Evidence, attribution consent, rights, privacy, and accessibility reviewed

maintenance_evidence.zh: 季度证据/权利重验与更正台账
maintenance_evidence.en: Quarterly evidence/rights recheck and correction ledger

exit_action.zh: 证据或同意撤回即更新/下架，并保留申诉
exit_action.en: Update/remove after evidence or consent withdrawal, with an appeal route

requirements.coverage_statement_zh: 三处地标嵌入 12 个成对布设的场景节点；三级荣誉展示体系和五类公共空间组件逐项规定准入证据、公共字段、维护复核与撤展/退出。

requirements.title_zh: 百年京张文化、中关村文化与AI新文化融合叙事设计
report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
风险、版权与合规说明
requirements.coverage_statement_zh: 铁路地层、书院庭园、大钟文化和双轨识别共同形成叙事；历史内容只使用登记来源并与总体 Logo 层级区分。

requirements.title_zh: 一带全球AI创新活动体系与长期运营设计
report_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划

status.zh: 工作名及概念运营链；名称/商标待清权，日期、主办方、合作方、场地与资源均未确定
status.en: Working title and concept operations chain; name/trademark clearance is pending, and dates, hosts, partners, sites, and resources are unconfirmed

developer_community.zh: 双语公开问题板、新人导读、行为准则和人工联系人；不收集非必要个人数据
developer_community.en: Bilingual public issue board, newcomer guide, code of conduct, and human contact; no unnecessary personal data

international_communication.zh: 双语问题卡、来源等级、场地/政府状态和征集边界
international_communication.en: Bilingual problem card with source class, site/government status, and call boundary

conversion_gate.zh: 仅当问题拥有者可联系、资料公开/已清权、预期用户与非 AI 基线明确时，合作线索才进入任务定义
conversion_gate.en: A lead enters task definition only with a reachable problem owner, public/cleared inputs, intended user, and non-AI baseline

required_evidence.zh: 线索来源、联系同意、问题定义、权利/数据初筛
required_evidence.en: Lead source, contact consent, problem definition, and rights/data triage

exit_state.zh: 待核线索；不宣布合作、不组建现场试点
exit_state.en: Lead pending verification; announce no partnership and assemble no field pilot

annual_brand_stage.zh: Q2 共研·开发者协作营

developer_community.zh: 公开任务、版本库、维护人值守、安全报告和贡献署名同意
developer_community.en: Open tasks, version repository, maintainer rota, security reporting, and contributor-attribution consent

international_communication.zh: 双语方法简报、可复现桌面原型、无障碍摘要和授权说明
international_communication.en: Bilingual method brief, reproducible desk prototype, accessible summary, and licence note

conversion_gate.zh: 数据、知识产权、安全、无障碍、人工复核和可维护性桌面审查全通过才可申请场地闸门
conversion_gate.en: Apply for a site gate only after desktop review passes data, IP, security, accessibility, human review, and maintainability

required_evidence.zh: 版本/变更日志、贡献者权利、威胁/风险清单、独立桌面复核
required_evidence.en: Version/change log, contributor rights, threat/risk list, and independent desk review

exit_state.zh: 作为开放研究原型归档，不进入公共场地或资源申请
exit_state.en: Archive as an open research prototype; do not apply for public space or resources

developer_community.zh: 项目维护人、场地值守、专业评审和公众申诉角色分离
developer_community.en: Separate project maintainer, site duty role, professional reviewer, and public-appeal owner

international_communication.zh: 双语试点卡、实时状态、风险/限制、非 AI 基线和停止方式
international_communication.en: Bilingual pilot card with live status, risks/limits, non-AI baseline, and stop route

conversion_gate.zh: 场地书面授权、责任主体、经复核边界、限时、维护资源、人工兜底、投诉和立即停止/恢复方案齐备时才启动
conversion_gate.en: Start only with written site authorisation, accountable body, reviewed boundary, timebox, maintenance resources, human fallback, complaint path, and immediate stop/restoration plan

required_evidence.zh: 授权与 RACI、基线、日志、事件/投诉、维护、停止演练和恢复记录
required_evidence.en: Authorisation and RACI, baseline, logs, incidents/complaints, maintenance, stop drill, and restoration record

exit_state.zh: 不启动或立即停止并恢复原公共服务；试点不默认转为常设
exit_state.en: Do not start, or stop immediately and restore the original public service; a pilot never becomes permanent by default

annual_brand_stage.zh: Q4 明鉴·公开复盘与目录

developer_community.zh: 维护人报告成功、失败和停止；公众/专业复核决定续期、缩减或终止
developer_community.en: Maintainers report success, failure, and termination; public/professional review decides renew, scale down, or stop

international_communication.zh: 双语场景目录、方法包、负面结果、纠错和版权/许可记录；只声称已验证范围
international_communication.en: Bilingual scenario catalogue, method package, negative results, corrections, and copyright/licence record; claim only the tested scope

conversion_gate.zh: 专业评估和公开复盘后只形成续期、缩减或停止；采购、投资、审批和异地复制须另走法定/专业程序
conversion_gate.en: After professional evaluation and public review, operations may only renew, scale down, or stop; procurement, investment, approval, and replication require separate lawful/professional processes

required_evidence.zh: 评估报告、申诉处置、复盘纪要、决定和执行/恢复记录
required_evidence.en: Evaluation report, appeal handling, minutes, decision, and execution/restoration record

exit_state.zh: 证据不足即缩减/停止；不声称绩效、背书、招商、投资或审批成果
exit_state.en: Scale down/stop when evidence is insufficient; claim no performance, endorsement, recruitment, investment, or approval

requirements.coverage_statement_zh: 工作名“明带开放验证季”以四季门槛串联年度活动品牌、开发者社区、双语国际传播和从合作线索到受控试点的转化；未通过即归档、缩减或停止，采购、投资与审批不自动发生。
